rows.detail: The delivery was DK'd for a reported quantity mismatch, but both supplied quantity records show 20,000 shares. The cause and correct instruction cannot be verified. The client allocation, repair item and inquiry log were not provided, so the correct side cannot be established before contacting the counterparty. The DTC receiver participant also conflicts with the counterparty participant on the BNY instruction.

emails.subject: Please check and re-instruct: CIM-261118-9595
emails.body:
Hello,

DTC reference DTC-DO-20261119-000044 was DK'd for a reported quantity mismatch. Our instruction and the supplied DTC activity both show 20,000 shares and USD 7,802,400 for ISIN US4370761029. Please check your latest allocation, quantity, amount and counterparty details, and re-instruct or confirm the correct details.

The DTC activity identifies participant 7101 as the receiver, while our instruction identifies 7101 as the counterparty. Please check this as well.

Thank you,
BNY Operations

emails.body:
Hello,

DTC reference DTC-DO-20261119-000044 was DK'd for a reported quantity mismatch. The supplied DTC activity and our instruction both show 20,000 shares and USD 7,802,400 for ISIN US4370761029. We have asked our client to check and re-instruct or confirm.
